t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Green, orange, yellow, and blue gnomes take you to one forest, others take you to another. Click one group at a time until the number of mushrooms goes down, then do the other group.

vb_textbox.text: Green, orange, yellow and green gnomes take you to one forest while the other colored ones take you to another. go one forest at a time, and basically exhaust it until you're getting 0,1,2 mushrooms out of it. Then switch to the other forest and repeat. Also, if you get to a point where both sides are only yielding low numbers, stick with one for 4-5 picks, then switch to the other.
